title: Teaching at the Cercle Culturel de Saint-Gratien
summary: For eighteen years he has taught trumpet, saxophone and drums three days a week at a music school and received a city medal; he is nearly 81.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: So, it made me 66. And I went out to -- but before I retired, I went out to -- I was passed out to this conservatory, where I'm at, actually --
It's in the 95th area. It's called the Cultural Cercle de Saint Gratien. It's a musical school.
now, for what, going on fifteen years, at least.
And you're still teaching out there --
Still teaching. Teaching three instruments; snare or traps, saxophone and trumpet.
On the 19th we gave a concert in the City.
A medal that the City gave you.
Yes, on the 19th, the 19th, yes. There is something I think we forget --
A couple. So, now, you're teaching what, two or three days a week; is that right?
Yes, I'll be 81 on the 10th of April.
Well, that seems pretty good to me.
